scope: Post-execution evidence classification, no policy/runtime change
rules: Infrastructure/import/transport/startup failures are invalid setup attempts, not task score zero.
Use original evaluator and completed bound receipts for scores; preserve raw 0-100 and normalized 0-1 scales.
Read RPC events in recorded call-id/sequence order; do not sort numeric names lexicographically.
A first failure is only assigned when a specific input, decision, response and subsequent behavior support it; otherwise mark unknown.
Return, planning feasibility, action acknowledgement, measured robot motion, visible object lift and task success are separate outcomes.
Do not infer a physical containment defect from a center-point surrogate alone.
Do not promote a policy from reused development/diagnostic layouts.

stages.evidence: Recorded scene RPC response plus corresponding RGB, initial layout identity and task instruction
Exact candidate branch and observed object/basket schema; distinguish geometry definitions and uncertainty
First attempted approach arm, XYZ and quaternion; compare the actual new target, not historical different targets
Recorded planner outcome or explicit planning exception; no-path is distinct from unreachable proof
RPC acknowledgement, action_steps and observed joint-state changes; keep safety-bound rejections separate
Next observation, recovery attempts, return reason and natural-terminal status
Original task evaluator and frozen selection criterion; unchanged scores legitimately retain pi05
